;Arts and culture
*[[Politics of Japan]]
**Former [[Japan]]ese [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Yasuhiro Nakasone]] celebrates his [[Centenarian|100th birthday]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-nakasone/former-japanese-pm-nakasone-turns-100-urges-constitutional-revision-idUSKCN1IS03Q (Reuters)]
*[[Politics of the United States]]
**Former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[George H. W. Bush]], aged 93, is hospitalized for observation due to [[hypotension]] (low [[blood pressure]]) and [[fatigue (medical)|fatigue]] at Southern Maine Health Care. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/former-us-president-george-hw-bush-taken-to-hospital-in-maine/ar-AAxSJYK?ocid=spartanntp&ffid=gz (Reuters)]   

;Disasters and accidents
*More than 200 departures are delayed and about 50 arrivals and departures are cancelled after lightning hit the [[aircraft fuel system]] at [[London Stansted Airport]]. Violent thunderstorm accompanied by heavy rain overnight caused flooding and property damage; the UK was struck by lightning more than 60,000 times in 24 hours, according to the [[Met Office]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/flights-delayed-after-lightning-strike-at-stansted-airport-11386800 (Sky News)] [https://news.sky.com/story/thunderstorms-light-up-london-and-they-could-last-for-days-11386689 (Sky News<sub>2</sub>)]

;Law and crime
*[[Mexican Drug War]]
**Mexican authorities arrest Rosalinda Garcia, the wife of [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] leader [[Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes]], one of the country's most wanted drug lords. [https://nypost.com/2018/05/27/mexico-arrests-wife-of-drug-lord-blamed-for-us-heroin-epidemic/ (''New York Post'')]
*[[Blockade of the Gaza Strip]], [[Human rights in the State of Palestine]]
**[[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Minister of Defense]] [[Avigdor Lieberman]] says that Israel has started building a "unique obstacle" along the [[Zikim]] beach, a three-story-high kind of [[Breakwater (structure)|breakwater]] designed to cut off the inhabitants of the [[Gaza Strip]] from access to Israel by the sea. The "impenetrable" structure made of stone and fence is expected to be completed before the end of this year. [http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20180527_03531619 (Belga via ''De Standaard'')] [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2018/May-27/450932-israel-begins-work-on-sea-barrier-to-prevent-gaza-infiltrations.ashx (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')]
**A member of a [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] committee tasked with breaking the siege says a ship will set off on Tuesday, carrying a number of injured Gazans and patients aboard. He does not specify the ship's first planned stop. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20180527-gaza-boats-will-attempt-to-break-israel-navy-siege-on-tuesday/ (MEMO)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Colombian presidential election, 2018]]
**Voters in [[Colombia]] go to the polls in the first round of a presidential election. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-44272907 (BBC News)] 
*[[Politics of Germany]]
**An estimated 20,000 people protest against an [[Alternative for Germany]] rally attracting 5,000 demonstrators in [[Berlin]]; 2,000 police are deployed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/05/berlin-thousands-gather-afd-counterrallies-180527115334438.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Politics of the State of Palestine]]
**[[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] [[President of Palestine|President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]]'s discharge from the hospital is delayed. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/05/27/palestinian-leader-mahmoud-abbas-release-from-hospital-is-delayed.html (Fox News)]
*[[Politics of Egypt]]
**Security sources say that prominent opposition leader [[Hazem Abdel-Azim]] has been detained. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-rights/egypt-detains-prominent-opposition-leader-former-sisi-supporter-sources-idUSKCN1IS0EH (Reuters)] [http://www.dw.com/en/former-presidential-compaigner-hazem-abdel-azim-detained-in-egypt/a-43952129 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Politics of Italy]]
**[[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] designate [[Giuseppe Conte]] gives up trying to form a government after [[President of Italy|President]] [[Sergio Mattarella]] earlier vetoed the nomination of technocrat [[Paolo Savona]] as [[Italian Minister of Finance|Minister of Finance]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-05-27/italy-s-president-vetoes-candidacy-of-euroskeptic-savona (Bloomberg)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Indian Premier League]]
**[[Chennai Super Kings]] defeat [[Sunrisers Hyderabad]] by 8 wickets in the final of the Indian Premier League to win the title for the third time. [http://www.espncricinfo.com/series/8048/report/1136620/chennai-super-kings-vs-sunrisers-hyderabad-final-ipl (Cricinfo)] 
*[[2018 IndyCar Series]]
**2014 IndyCar Series champion [[Will Power]] of Australia wins the 102nd running of the [[2018 Indianapolis 500|Indianapolis 500]]. It is [[Danica Patrick]]'s final race before her retirement. [https://www.nbcsports.com/video/2018-indy-500-danica-patrick-crashes-out-will-power-wins-first-time (NBC Sports)]
